correctness.rationale: Exact mean-field polynomial f(p) and normalized response P_i(z)=a_i z-b_i z^3 were reconstructed. Since a_i-3b_i=3(u_i-v_i)>=0, P_i map [0,1] increasingly into [0,1], and each two-step composition is strictly concave on (0,1). Thus G_i(z)/z decreases, giving unique positive fixed point iff product>1, monotone attraction on each signed half-line, no extra periodic orbits of the monotone two-step map, and critical reciprocal-square asymptotics with K_A=a_A b_B+b_A a_B^3>0, K_B=a_B b_A+b_B a_A^3>0. This applies to deterministic infinite-population sampling, not finite-population trajectories.
